'    true = [rng.randint(-10 ** 6, 10 ** 6) for _ in range(K)]
    meas = []
    for a in range(1, K):
        b = rng.randrange(a)
        d = true[b] - true[a]
        meas.append([b, a, d - rng.randint(0, 500), d + rng.randint(0, 500)])
    for _ in range(2000):
        a = rng.randrange(K); b = rng.randrange(K)
        d = true[b] - true[a]
        meas.append([a, b, d - rng.randint(0, 500), d + rng.randint(0, 500)])
